'''Petra Nihrum''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] along with her sister [[Mina Nihrum|Mina]].<ref name="Storming the Castle">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Storming the Castle|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref>

==Biography==
As a teenager, Petra and her sister Mina, faced a tragedy when their [[Parent/Legends|parents]] died in a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] accident. Other family members stepped in to raise the sisters, and when their uncle found a new opportunity on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], the sisters followed the rest of their family to their new home.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Petra and Mina Nihrum}}</ref>

For a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]], life was calm until mercenaries targeted [[Alien/Legends|alien]] settlers on Taris, killing many, including their two uncles, grandfather, and several cousins. Left as refugees with nothing, the sisters fled to Ord Mantell, where a friend of Mina offered them a place to stay. Now living in the [[Kessan's Landing]] on Ord Mantell, a tough place with limited job opportunities and support, the sisters learned how to deal with their reality by clinging to each other.<ref name="Codex" />

[[File:Petra_Nihrum_fires.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Petra fires her blaster during the fight against the Hidden Chain.]]
Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref> Kessan's Landing was [[raid on Kessan's Landing|raided]] by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the [[Hidden Chain]] seeking to abduct civilians. Mina was among those who were captured and prepared to be shipped off-world. Petra went out seeking for her, but had to take a detour in order to stabilize the unstable [[Geothermal Station|power station]] where she met the [[Alliance Commander]]. Agreeing to work with them despite her reservations, Petra helped the Commander avert the immediate meltdown of the power plant, but their search for a more permanent solution was postponed by the news of the hostages.<ref name="Best Laid Plans">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Best Laid Plans|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref>

With the Commander's help, Petra was able to rescue her sister and the others and told them to head to safety while stuck by Commander's side. Together, they confronted the leader of the raid [[Tyrus Brokenblade]], who managed to seriously injure Petra during the fighting. The Commander captured Tyrus with the help of [[Sa'har Kateen]], but Petra quietly slipped away to check on her sister.<ref name="Storming the Castle" />

==Behind the scenes==
Petra makes a brief cameo during the final cutscene of ''Legacy Reborn''. If the player chose to save Mina, she will appear in the cutscene alongside her sister. If the player did not save Mina, Petra will appear in the cutscene alone.<ref name="Legacy Reborn">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Legacy Reborn|[[Khar Shian]]}}</ref>
